item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 reporting showing Hasina created independent complaint channels, empowered civilian oversight bodies, or ordered genuinely independent investigations into abuse by police, military, or Awami League-aligned enforcers. I also did not find credible evidence that politically protected actors were meaningfully disciplined through domestic processes in 2024. The only counterevidence is her post-fleeing call for an investigation, which is too late and too narrow to count as building a system.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described a nationwide curfew and internet/text shutdown as the state escalated against protesters; that is the opposite of transparent complaint handling or civilian oversight and suggests suppression of scrutiny.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s crackdown on protesters left more than 170 dead, U.N. says","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said the crackdown left more than 170 dead and warned that internet shutdowns increase impunity; this is strong evidence against any functioning system for independent investigation or restraint of abusive actors.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.5","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh back UN investigation of grave abuses","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"August 26, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/26/bangladesh-back-un-investigation-grave-abuses","summary":"HRW said the crackdown was the deadliest in recent Bangladeshi history, with excessive force by law enforcement and Awami League-affiliated youth violence; the report implies the state did not prevent or punish abuse by politically protected actors.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.1","3B.2","2B.5","2B.9"]},{"title":"Former Bangladesh PM Hasina demands probe into July \"killings and vandalism\"","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/former-bangladesh-pm-hasina-demands-probe-into-july-killings-and-vandalism/2222256/","summary":"After fleeing, Hasina called for an investigation into the killings and vandalism; this is the closest pro-accountability signal, but it is post-hoc and does not show she had built or used an effective accountability system while in power.","question_ids":["3B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"UN fact-finding team issues call for submissions","publisher":"United Nations in Bangladesh / OHCHR","date":"September 16, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/278741-un-fact-finding-team-issues-call-submissions","summary":"The UN opened a fact-finding process for alleged violations from July 1 to August 15, 2024;
